review.note: Retracted in M41b: the pan-European exchange that operates the Lisbon bourse among seven others, spun off from ICE in 2014. The atlas holds nothing about the Lisbon stock exchange at all — not its merger into Euronext in 2002, not the PSI, not a single listing — so there is no Portuguese record for a European exchange to be joined to. It is also the only one of the 42 that is not a Portuguese body.
